AUTHOR: Myrvold
TITLE: Monitoring Fish Assemblages in Seasonal Off-Channel Habitats Using Underwater Video and Computer Vision
REGION: Gudbrandsdalslågen River backwater slough (Lake Mjøsa delta), Norway
SPECIES: perch, pike, bream, roach, ide, Eurasian minnow, nine-spine stickleback, common dace, tadpole (Bufo/Rana)
DATA: Own continuous fixed-camera video, 2020 (training, 171 min annotated) and 2021 (113 x 30-s test clips)
V_EV: Sec. 2.7: 'We scored the clips by the following categories: footage colour (day/night); murkiness (clear/moderate/murky); algal growth on the camera lens (yes/no); and backlight'
D2: Train/val on 2020 footage; test on 113 clips from 2021 season
D_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'The computer vision model was developed based on the 2020 material and tested on the 2021 material.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'developed based on the 2020 material and tested on the 2021 material'; in-domain mAP 0.95 vs 2021 ICC are different metrics
C_EV: Sec. 2.7: 'we recorded the total number of specimens of each species at prediction probability level cutoffs ranging from 20% to 90% in 5% increments'
E_EV: Sec. 2.7: 'we compared manually derived species counts to the results of the software ... the manual results were treated as the ground truth'
ARCH: YOLOv5 + SORT tracking, track-level majority label and mean prediction probability
METR: mAP@0.5 (validation), confusion matrix, MOTA/MOTP, ICC between true and predicted counts, ANOVA of count error vs conditions
NOTE: Temporal split by year (2020 train, 2021 test) coded D1=조사일 (closest category). Different year at same site counted as external (계절/시기). R3=N because in-domain (validation mAP 0.95) and 2021 test (ICC of counts) use different metrics; verifier may consider R3=Y. Murkiness/day-night/backlight scored categorically by observers; one-way ANOVA of count error by these factors (V6=P, V7=Y); only day/night significant. Optimum cutoffs per species chosen by ICC (justified threshold -> C_ALL P). Objects counted not individuals (re-entries counted twice), so no duplicate handling (C5=없음). Tracking MOTA 0.94 on one limited clip.
